description: This is a FastAPI route definitions file for the IPL Team Analytics API. It defines various endpoints for retrieving team information, KPIs, top players, boundary analysis, run rates, wicket types, dot-ball stats, yearly performance, and head-to-head records. The endpoints utilize an AnalyticsEngine for data retrieval and respond with structured Pydantic models.

classes.description: FastAPI's routing component used to define API endpoints.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: Exception class used to generate HTTP error responses.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Helper function for declaring path operation parameters with metadata.

classes.name: AnalyticsEngine
classes.description: Engine class responsible for data retrieval and processing for IPL analytics.

classes.description: Response model containing list of IPL teams.

classes.description: Response model for team KPI overview.
